messages.subject: memory.size error
parts:
Hi all, I am currently using rstanarm for one of my projects.

While using the posterior_predict function I encountered this error. I will appreciate any ideas on how I can go around this problem.

Thanks.

Error: cannot allocate vector of size 4.2 Gb
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In array(STATS, dims[perm]) :
  Reached total allocation of 8072Mb: see help(memory.size)
2: In array(STATS, dims[perm]) :
  Reached total allocation of 8072Mb: see help(memory.size)

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: memory.size error
parts: On Thursday, December 8, 2016 at 2:48:24 PM UTC-5, malai...@gmail.com wrote:
While using the posterior_predict function I encountered this error. I will appreciate any ideas on how I can go around this problem.
Error: cannot allocate vector of size 4.2 Gb

Specify the draws argument to posterior_predict() to be some number small enough to be consistent with the amount of RAM you have.

Ben

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: memory.size error
parts:
For now I think Ben's recommendation of using the 'draws' argument is probably the only option. Going forward there might be ways we can reduce the memory consumption in posterior_predict. There are probably unnecessary copies being made in some places (I think Rob pointed out a few recently). 

Jonah
